Here is the round trip for a single tool call:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    U[You] -->|prompt| C[Chatty]
    C -->|messages + tools| L[LLM]
    L -->|tool call| T[Tool runner]
    T -->|result| L
    L -->|answer| C
    C -->|transcript| U
```
I only have scripted answers in this demo.
